name: Hokm
howTo:
Partners sit across from each other. First team to win 7 tricks takes the round; first team to 7 rounds wins.

# Setup
- 4 players in 2 teams. Deal 5 cards each first.
- The Hakem (the dealer here) looks at their 5 cards and picks trump: tap the Trump selector.
- Then deal the rest, 13 cards each.

# Play
- The Hakem leads the first trick. Follow suit if you can; otherwise play any card, including trump.
- Highest trump wins the trick, otherwise the highest card of the suit led. The winner taps Take trick (it goes to their team) and leads next.

# Scoring
- The first team to take 7 tricks wins the round and scores 1.
- If the Hakem's team wins the round, the same Hakem goes again. If not, the Hakem passes to the next player round the table.
- First team to 7 points wins the game.

# Robots
- Short of 4? Games → + 🤖 Robot adds robot players; partners sit across. The dealer is always a person.
- If the Hakem (who starts the round) is a robot, it picks trump from its first 5 cards and says so in chat. Then deal the rest. A robot that wins a trick takes it.
